plan.title: QCS excludes bid above vendor price ceiling

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the single product needed for the bid.
Invite the vendor named in the test case.
Set Vendor A's maximum allowed net price to 150 before the bid is submitted.
Verify that the 150 price ceiling was saved.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal to submit the test bid.
Open this RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit the bid whose landed price is 200, above the saved ceiling.
Return to the buyer portal to inspect QCS.
Open the buyer's Master QCS for the submitted RFQ bid.
Assert that the above-ceiling bid is excluded from the QCS bidder ranking columns.
